title: Micheal's guns
description: Gun mod that I made for a friend. very simple. yknow.. adds guns?
body:
Micheal's guns adds 3 guns (currently) to the game. I'm very new to the modding community, so expect every single bug you can imagine. The guns include a simple pistol, a shotgun, and a rifle. Thanks for playing!

# What's new!

In celebration of the first version of my mod being released, I have put in some work and now give you 3D GUN MODELS! (The old ones were terrible anyway.)

I have also tweaked the damage of the guns to make the power balance better (totally not the cheapest gun being the best)

##  Known issues

 I am new to MCreator, and this is my first attempt; it will improve over time.

- In first person, the guns are 90 degrees turned, and I'm not sure how to fix it (if you know how pls comment) 

# Coming soon (idk when I feel like it)

- Moar gunz

- better shotgun physics,

- better ammo

- Maybe an update to Neoforge?

- Also, update to newer versions.

btw idk how to backport yet, so not anything 1.20 and below yet.

YAYAY MODRINTH :)
Bye-bye, enjoy me mod.
